reviews.text: The most beloved veterinarian. Dr. Luís is a wonderful person. My cat had a very complicated surgery and they accompanied us throughout the entire process in a humane and supportive way. We can only express our gratitude for taking such good care of our little cat.
The service was extremely friendly and attentive.

I had an emergency with my dog, and I wasn't even a client of the clinic (my usual vet was on vacation). Right from the first contact, they immediately made themselves available to see him. From the doctors to the staff, everything was excellent; observation, supervision, and communication were top-notch. Problem solved! I highly recommend them.

Fantastic service
Dr. Luís Cruz is a doctor with extensive experience and knowledge, and is very humane.
Always available and with enormous empathy for us and our animals. Well done!
Carlos Carneiro de Sousa
Excellent professional
Thank you so much to Dr. Luís Cruz and the team for the support they gave me. I will never forget the humanity with which they treated Nuga.
Thank you Joana for trusting us and entrusting us with what is most precious to you ♥️! We will take care of it!

I asked them to pass by to give calming medicine for my cat because we have an emergency, they said they don't consider this as an emergency service.. Not helpful at all, although I told them I was willing to pay the consultation, other veterinaries said I can pass by even if it's emergency. I preferred this one because it was closer to my home. Disappointed
The best veterinarian in Lisbon.

I didn't like it. This was the second time I used this place and it was always the same. I had to wait much longer than the scheduled time. I paid a lot for things I didn't get. They mixed up the exams and I don't even know if the reports I received belonged to my pet. Never again.
I recommend... always helping animals and their owners.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to Dr. Luís, Dr. Diogo, and of course, Diana. She was with us during Jay's final moments. Thank you so much for your care, compassion, and kindness ♥️. During such a painful time for our family, we felt supported and respected.

Today is a very sad day for my friend Bela, who lost her little girl, Daisy.
I want to thank Dr. Luís Cruz for his professionalism, his dedication, and especially his humanity towards the animals, but also towards their owners, and Dr. Diogo, who never lost his good humor even when the situation was bad. Daisy's owner is currently unable to thank you because the sadness she feels prevents her from speaking, but believe me, her gratitude is enormous.

THANK YOU 💖

Good morning
Many thanks to Dr. Luis and the entire team for the care, professionalism, and affection they have always shown to ICE, the dog that keeps my mother company.

ICE was attacked in the street by another dog during the summer, suffering serious injuries. On the same day, Dr. Luis and his team were always available to assist, treat, and help ICE recover.
Friendly and efficient service
Excellent support for my dear Didi at the end of her life! Thank you.
Excellent team: attentive, caring, communicative, and trustworthy. Very competent!!!
Dr. Luís Cruz's service is always top-notch. Dedicated and always offering his constant teachings and kindness.
Dr. Luis is a very special veterinarian. While the outcome was not what I had hoped, he and his staff were kind, compassionate, and went beyond my expectations in a very difficult situation.

These days it's rare to find someone so dedicated to their profession and with so much empathy for their "patients" as Dr. Luís. Even with a busy schedule, he never turns his back on an emergency. Well done.
